b14g.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
b14g.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

b14g.cost: $150 of capital and about $2 of CORE fees
b14g.text: Deposit $150 of CORE into the dualCORE vault at app.b14g.xyz, where b14g auto-matches it with BTC for dual-staking and issues the tradable dualCORE receipt token.

b14g.cost: $150 of capital and about $2 of fees
b14g.text: Alternatively, post a merge order on the b14g Merge Marketplace with BTC or CORE and pair with a counterparty to unlock the boosted dual-staking tier for both sides.
Check the b14g points balance in the app; points are described as eventually redeemable for a future $B14G token, which is unlaunched and unconfirmed.

Hold for at least 30 days, and note the 31 October 2026 exploit in which about $1.47M of CORE was withdrawn without authorisation from the Marketplace contract (BTC was unaffected); size the position accordingly.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record your b14g points balance each week.

bittensor-dtao.cost: no fee to create the wallet
bittensor-dtao.text: Set up a fresh wallet in the Bittensor wallet app or the Talisman wallet, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

bittensor-dtao.cost: $150 of capital plus exchange withdrawal fees
bittensor-dtao.text: Buy $150 of TAO on an exchange, transfer it to your Bittensor wallet, then stake it to root (netuid 0) so it stays TAO-denominated and earns a share of block emissions.
Alternatively, stake TAO into a subnet pool, for example SN64 Chutes or SN52 Dojo, via taostats.io or Backprop, swapping TAO for that subnet's alpha token at the pool price.
Each week, check your staking rewards and the alpha price of any subnet you staked into; alpha can fall against TAO, so move back to root stake if a subnet weakens.
Hold the stake for at least 30 days; there is no unbonding period for plain unstaking, so the hold is for emission coverage, not a lock-up.
Write the wallet address, subnet IDs, stake dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record your TAO and alpha balances each week.

clearstar.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
clearstar.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

clearstar.cost: $150 of capital and about $2 of Flare fees
clearstar.text: Swap XRP into FXRP on Flare, then deposit $150 of FXRP into the Clearstar earnXRP vault on Upshift (app.upshift.finance) and hold the earnXRP receipt token.
Open the Upshift Points page and confirm the early-depositor points bonus on the earnXRP vault is still live; those points belong to Upshift, not Clearstar.

clearstar.cost: $150 of capital and about $4 of gas
clearstar.text: Alternatively, deposit stablecoins into a Clearstar-curated vault on Morpho or Euler on Base or Ethereum for plain lending yield.
Hold for at least 30 days; standard earnXRP withdrawals take 72 hours (instant withdrawal costs a small fee), so plan exits ahead of time.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record the vault yield each week.

gauntlet.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
gauntlet.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

gauntlet.cost: $150 of capital and about $4 of gas
gauntlet.text: Deposit $150 of USDC into the Gauntlet USDC Prime vault on Morpho on Base, Gauntlet's largest vault, and hold the vault share token while Gauntlet's risk engine allocates it.

gauntlet.cost: about $8 of gas to move funds
gauntlet.text: Compare the Prime, Core and Frontier tiers in Gauntlet's vault book and, if you want more yield, move part of the deposit into Gauntlet USDC Core on Ethereum.
Check Merkl each week for MORPHO or partner rewards attached to the vault and claim only from the link Morpho itself publishes.
Hold the position for at least 30 days; the Gauntlet USDG Premium V2 vault on Arbitrum also earns Arbitrum DRIP Season 2 ARB if you farm there instead.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and save the Merkl claim receipts alongside it.

hive-protocol.cost: no fee to create the wallet
hive-protocol.text: Open a fresh Bitcoin wallet that holds only the BTC you plan to stake, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.
Bridge $150 of BTC to B-squared Network and stake it through the B-squared Hive staking layer to secure the network and earn $B2 token rewards.
Check the staking rewards accrue in $B2 in the B-squared Hub and confirm the 1-day unstaking lock, so you know when funds become movable again.
Optionally stake the earned $B2 itself or delegate it to a B-squared sequencer for additional rewards, instead of selling it immediately.
Hold the BTC stake for at least 30 days; the B-squared Buzz and Odyssey points campaigns ended at the April 2025 TGE, so the return now is $B2 staking rewards, not points.
Write the wallet address, stake dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record your $B2 rewards each week.

hyperithm.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
hyperithm.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

hyperithm.cost: $150 of capital and about $4 of gas
hyperithm.text: Bridge $150 of USDC to Monad and deposit it into the Hyperithm USDC Apex vault on Morpho, the largest Hyperithm-curated vault, and hold the vault share token.

hyperithm.cost: $150 of capital and about $4 of gas
hyperithm.text: Alternatively, deposit into the Saturn USDC vault curated by Hyperithm on Monad or Ethereum to earn 5x Saturn Orbital Points (Season 2) on top of lending yield.
Check the Accountable aHYPER delta-neutral vault on Monad as a second option, but note its withdrawals run on a fixed weekly schedule, not instantly.
Hold the position for at least 30 days and re-check the vault's collateral and caps weekly, since Hyperithm rebalances allocations as markets move.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record your Saturn Orbital Points balance each week.

k3-capital.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
k3-capital.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

k3-capital.cost: $150 of capital and about $4 of gas
k3-capital.text: Bridge $150 of WETH to Monad and deposit it into the K3 Capital Earn WETH vault on Euler, K3's largest vault, and hold the k3WETH share token.

k3-capital.cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas
k3-capital.text: Alternatively, deposit BOLD into the sBOLD vault, a tokenised Liquity V2 stability-pool vault, to earn stability-pool yield through K3's curation.
Check the Euler or Morpho app weekly for any live partner incentives on K3 vaults; past ones (Neutral Points, Plasma WXPL) have expired, so do not assume any are active.
Hold the position for at least 30 days; K3 takes about a 10% performance fee, so check the net yield after fees before topping up.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record the vault yield each week.

lightning-network.cost: no fee to create the wallet
lightning-network.text: Set up a fresh Bitcoin wallet that holds only the BTC you plan to lock in channels, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

lightning-network.cost: $150 of BTC plus on-chain funding fees
lightning-network.text: Install a Lightning node (LND, or a packaged node such as Umbrel or Start9), sync a full Bitcoin node first, and fund it with $150 of BTC.
lightning-network.time: 2 to 6 hours to sync and set up

lightning-network.cost: about $1 to $5 of on-chain fees per channel
lightning-network.text: Open payment channels with well-connected peers, splitting the $150 across at least two channels so payments can route through your node in both directions.

lightning-network.cost: electricity and uptime, no extra fee
lightning-network.text: Set your routing fees (a small base fee plus a fee rate in parts per million) and keep the node online 24/7; you earn only when payments physically route through you.

lightning-network.cost: about $1 to $5 of on-chain fees per rebalance
lightning-network.text: Keep the node running for at least 30 days and rebalance channels weekly; expect modest income (a few dollars a month for a hobby node) and watch on-chain open and close fees.
Write the node ID, channel IDs, peers, fees earned and on-chain costs in a farm log, so you can see whether routing income beats the channel costs.

nonce-capital.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
nonce-capital.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

nonce-capital.cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas
nonce-capital.text: Deposit $150 of ETH into the ether.fi Liquid ETH vault on Ethereum, a Veda BoringVault strategy curated by Nonce Capital, and hold the receipt token.
Check the Ether.fi Loyalty Points your Liquid balance earns in the ether.fi app, and note the Cash membership tier it counts toward.

nonce-capital.cost: $150 of capital and about $4 of gas
nonce-capital.text: Alternatively, deposit $150 of USDC into the ether.fi Liquid USD vault on Optimism for the stablecoin version of the same Nonce-curated strategy.
Hold the position for at least 30 days and review Nonce's published strategy limits for the vault before any large top-up.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record your Loyalty Points balance each week.

onre.text: Open a fresh Solana wallet (Phantom or Solflare) that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

onre.cost: $150 of capital and under $1 of fees
onre.text: Deposit $150 of sUSDe on Solana at app.onre.finance to mint ONyc, the yield-bearing reinsurance token, and hold it for 1x OnRe Points plus the base reinsurance yield.
Open the OnRe Points page at app.onre.finance and confirm your points are accruing hourly; the leaderboard snapshots daily at 00:00 UTC.
Supply the ONyc as lending collateral on Kamino or in the Loopscale OnRe USDC vault for a 3x points multiplier, or LP it on Orca for 2x.
Hold for at least 30 days; for the top 4x multiplier, hold YT-ONyc from Exponent yield-trading instead of plain ONyc, only if you understand yield-token risk.
Write the wallet address, deposit dates and every transaction signature in a farm log, and record your OnRe Points balance each week.

opentrade.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
opentrade.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

opentrade.cost: $150 of capital and about $2 of Avalanche fees
opentrade.text: Open a Littio account and put $150 of USDC into a Littio Yield Pot on Avalanche, which runs on OpenTrade's Flexible Term USDC vault, to earn Treasury-backed yield.
Alternatively, use the WOO X RWA Flexible Term Vault or a Plume Nest vault backed by OpenTrade and WisdomTree funds, and compare their published yields first.

opentrade.cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas
opentrade.text: If you qualify for direct access, complete OpenTrade's onboarding (KYB) at opentrade.io, select the Flexible Term USDC vault, approve the USDC spend and deposit; you receive ERC-4626 vault tokens that accrue interest daily.
Hold the position for at least 30 days; OpenTrade pays yield on deposited stablecoins, not points, so the return is the vault's daily-accruing interest.
Write the wallet address, partner app, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record the vault yield each week.

plume-vaults.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
plume-vaults.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

plume-vaults.cost: $150 of capital and about $2 of Plume fees
plume-vaults.text: Deposit $150 of USDC into the Nest nTBILL vault on Plume (nest.credit) and hold the nTBILL token for Treasury-backed yield plus Plume Nest Points.
Open the Plume Nest Points page and confirm your PNP balance and whether the current season is still live; Season One was scheduled through March 2026, so verify the season before depositing more.
Deploy the nTOKEN into partner DeFi for a boost: lend it on Morpho or Loopscale, LP it, or strip yield on Pendle, which Plume lists as boosted PNP routes.
Compare the other Nest vaults, nALPHA (Hamilton Lane private credit), nOPAL (Brazilian receivables) and nWISDOM (WisdomTree), and hold at least 30 days for snapshot coverage.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record your PNP balance each week.

r25.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
r25.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

r25.cost: $150 of capital and about $2 of Pharos fees
r25.text: Subscribe $150 of USDC into the R25 Axil Prime Credit Vault on Pharos via a partner wallet (Binance Wallet, OKX or the R25 dApp) and note the 3-month lock and redemption window.
Check whether a partner campaign is live, for example a Binance Wallet PROS rewards campaign on the Axil vault, and confirm the subscription window before depositing.

r25.cost: $150 of capital and under $1 of Sui fees
r25.text: Alternatively, on Sui, hold rcUSD and stake it for rcUSDp, the yield-bearing receipt token backed by tokenised money-market funds.
Hold the Axil vault position for its full 3-month term; missed redemption windows auto-roll into the next cycle, so set a reminder two weeks before maturity.
Write the wallet address, vault name, subscription dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and set a calendar reminder for the redemption window.

rockawayx.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
rockawayx.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

rockawayx.cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas
rockawayx.text: Deposit $150 of USDC into the RockawayX USDC Prime vault (rxUSDCp) on Morpho on Ethereum, the conservative tier, and hold the vault share token.

rockawayx.cost: $150 of capital and under $1 of fees
rockawayx.text: Alternatively, deposit into the RockawayX RWA USDC vault on Kamino on Solana, which allocates across OnRe ONyc, Huma and Figure markets, for diversified RWA lending yield.
Each week, check the vault's allocation and yield on the Morpho or Kamino app; RockawayX rebalances the vault, so your job is to verify the position is still live.
Hold the position for at least 30 days; there is no points program here, so the value is lending yield plus any incentives the underlying venue pays.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record the vault yield each week.

saturn.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
saturn.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

saturn.cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas
saturn.text: Swap $150 of USDC for USDat 1:1 in the Saturn app (app.saturn.credit) on Ethereum and hold it to earn Orbital Points in Season 2.

saturn.cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas
saturn.text: Stake the USDat into the sUSDat ERC-4626 vault for STRC-backed yield (targeting about 11%) and note the roughly 7-day unstake queue.
For higher multipliers, LP USDat or sUSDat on Curve (25x Orbital Points) or hold YT-USDat on Pendle (30x), and check the live multipliers in Saturn's docs first.

Hold for at least 30 days; check Saturn's docs for the Season 2 snapshot date (TGE or 8 December 2026, whichever comes first) and whether address registration at claim.saturn.credit is still open; US, UK and EU persons are excluded.
Write the wallet address, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record your Orbital Points balance each week.

steakhouse-financial.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
steakhouse-financial.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

steakhouse-financial.cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas
steakhouse-financial.text: Deposit $150 of USDC into the Steakhouse USDC Prime vault on Morpho on Ethereum, the lowest-risk tier, and hold the vault share token while Steakhouse curates the allocations.
Check the same vault's rewards on Merkl and claim any MORPHO or partner incentives the vault accrues, claiming only from the link Morpho itself publishes.
Once a week, top up the vault or move a small amount between Steakhouse Prime and High Yield USDC so the wallet shows repeat activity across more than one snapshot.
Hold the position for at least 30 days; if you use the Steakhouse USDG Pro V2 vault on Arbitrum instead, check its Arbitrum DRIP Season 2 ARB rewards on Merkl before withdrawing.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and save the Merkl claim receipts alongside it.

symbiotic.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
symbiotic.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

symbiotic.cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas
symbiotic.text: Deposit $150 of wstETH into a Symbiotic vault at app.symbiotic.fi and delegate the collateral to operators securing a network, earning Symbiotic Points in Season 2.
Open the Symbiotic Points page and confirm your hourly accrual; points depend on how much vault TVL is allocated to network adapters, so check the vault's allocation.

symbiotic.cost: about $8 of gas to move funds
symbiotic.text: Consider the TANSSI vault instead, which pays TANSSI rewards on top of Symbiotic Points, or a HYPER vault securing Hyperlane, and compare their unstake windows first.
Hold for at least 30 days; note the unstake delay (up to 14 days on the TANSSI vault) and that slashing risk applies per network you secure.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record your Symbiotic Points balance each week.

upshift.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
upshift.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

upshift.cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas
upshift.text: Deposit $150 of USDC into the Upshift USDC vault at app.upshift.finance and hold the upUSDC receipt token to earn Upshift Points in Season 2.
Open the Upshift Points page and confirm your points balance and the live multiplier; a 5x deposit bonus applies until total Upshift TVL reaches $750M, so check whether it is still live.
Deploy the upUSDC receipt token as collateral on Morpho, or the hgETH receipt token on Euler, to earn extra points from the composability routes Upshift lists.
Hold the position for at least 30 days and complete a weekly mission on the Points page, since points decay over time and early depositors earn more.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record your Upshift Points balance each week.

usdd.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
usdd.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

usdd.cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas
usdd.text: Swap $150 of USDC for USDD on Ethereum and stake it in the sUSDD savings vault at app.usdd.io to receive the ERC-4626 sUSDD yield token.
Alternatively, bridge USDD to TRON and stake it through JustLend supply mining, or provide USDD-TRX liquidity on SunSwap, for the TRON-side yield.
Each week, check the sUSDD vault rate and the peg on the USDD app, and top up or rebalance only if the rate beats your current position.
Hold sUSDD for at least 30 days; it has no lock-up and instant withdrawals, so the hold is for snapshot coverage, not a contract requirement.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and note the sUSDD rate on the day you staked.

veda.cost: under $3 of gas for the first transaction
veda.text: Open a fresh self-custody wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, write its seed phrase on paper and store it offline, and never connect it to links from social media.

veda.cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas
veda.text: Deposit $150 of LBTC into the Lombard DeFi Vault, built on Veda's BoringVault infrastructure, and hold the LBTCv receipt token to earn 3x Veda Points plus Lombard Lux.
Open the Veda Points dashboard and confirm your deposit is tracked; points accrue by USD value and days held, so note the start date (the dashboard is blocked in the US).

veda.cost: $150 of capital and about $8 of gas
veda.text: Alternatively, deposit $150 of ETH into the ether.fi Liquid ETH vault on Ethereum, another Veda-powered vault, and check the Ether.fi Loyalty Points it earns.
Hold the position for at least 45 days; Veda Points reward long-term holders, so avoid withdrawing and re-depositing just to show activity.
Write the wallet address, vault name, deposit dates and every transaction hash in a farm log, and record your Veda Points balance each week.
